$description: Every theme the build writes, in the order it writes them. Each needs a tokens/semantic/color.<name>.json holding the same keys as light's, and may add a typography.<name>.json and a radius.<name>.json that replace shared styles and radii inside its own block. Light and dark are the two automatic themes: light sits on :root, and dark follows the system unless [data-theme="light"] is set. Every other theme is never automatic and applies only under :root[data-theme="<name>"], so it needs no selector here. colorScheme is what the browser draws native controls and scrollbars in. A list rather than an object, because an object would put a name made of digits, such as 1984, first.
